console.title: Console
overview.subtitle: Data collected now, read-only. Nothing changes when WinCare opens.
overview.findings-empty: No alerts based on the collected data (or diagnostics are still running).
overview.method: Each alert follows a rule with a documented threshold (docs/METODOLOGIA.md). WinCare does not compute a "health score".
card.integrity-hint: Official checks arrive in phase F3; nothing runs automatically.
finding.disk-system-critical.title: System disk {0} almost full: {1} GB free ({2}%)
finding.disk-system-critical.recommendat: Free space before updates or repairs. Use Settings > System > Storage; WinCare controlled cleanup arrives in phase F3.
finding.disk-system-low.title: Low space on system disk {0}: {1} GB free ({2}%)
finding.disk-system-low.recommendation: Review large and temporary files. Windows updates need free space.
finding.disk-system-hdd.title: Windows is on an HDD ({0})
finding.disk-system-hdd.recommendation: Mechanical disks limit boot and app launch times. Moving to an SSD is the most effective improvement in this case.
finding.disk-other-low.title: Low space on drive {0}: {1} GB free ({2}%)
finding.disk-other-low.recommendation: Check whether the drive holds data that can be archived.
finding.memory-high.title: High memory use at collection time: {0}%
finding.memory-high.recommendation: See Startup and processes for the programs using most memory. This is a point sample; collect again to confirm.
finding.cpu-high-sample.title: High CPU in the 1 s sample: {0}%
finding.cpu-high-sample.recommendation: A short sample does not indicate a persistent problem. Collect again; if it stays high, investigate processes.
finding.reboot-pending.title: Reboot pending ({0})
finding.reboot-pending.recommendation: Restart before diagnostics or repairs: pending updates change the results.
finding.uptime-long.title: Running for {0} days without a restart
finding.uptime-long.recommendation: Restarting completes updates and frees resources. Informational, not a fault.
finding.windows-out-of-matrix.title: Edition outside the planned matrix: {0} {1} (build {2})
finding.windows-out-of-matrix.recommenda: Diagnostics work, but future maintenance actions may be blocked on this edition. See docs/COMPATIBILIDADE.md.
finding.defender-inactive.title: Microsoft Defender service inactive
finding.defender-inactive.recommendation: Another antivirus/EDR may be managing protection. Confirm with IT; WinCare never changes antivirus settings.
finding.firewall-profile-off.title: Windows Firewall disabled in at least one profile
finding.firewall-profile-off.recommendat: Confirm with IT whether another solution covers the firewall. WinCare does not change firewall settings.
diagnostics.intro: Read-only collection via CIM/WMI and registry. Every step is written to the audit log.
storage.intro: Fixed volumes. Media type (HDD/SSD) shows when Windows reports it; otherwise "Unknown".
startup.intro: Read-only. Memory = current working set. CPU = processor time accumulated since the process started (not a current %).
startup.entries: Startup items (Run keys and Startup folders)
security.intro: Management signals and protection state, read-only. WinCare never changes Defender, Firewall, BitLocker, Windows Update, GPO, MDM, EDR or VPN.
reports.intro: Export the current diagnostics. Reports stay on this computer.
settings.profile-note: No profile disables Defender, Firewall, BitLocker, Windows Update, GPO, MDM, EDR, VPN or authentication. This version only has read actions.
profile.Diagnostico.desc: Read-only. No changes to the system.
profile.Conservador.desc: Low-risk maintenance, with confirmation per action.
profile.Corporativo.desc: Low risk, and blocks any action sensitive to managed policies even when management is not detected.
profile.Avancado.desc: Extra actions for technicians, always with individual confirmation.
col.Label: Label
col.Name: Name
report.title: Diagnostic report - WinCare Enterprise
report.no-findings: No alerts based on the collected data.
report.footer: Generated by WinCare Enterprise. Read-only data from collection time; thresholds in docs/METODOLOGIA.md.
action.diag.system: Collect Windows, CPU and memory data
policy.risk-above-profile: The action risk is above what the profile allows.
policy.managed-device: Blocked: the device is managed by the organization.
policy.managed-strict: Blocked by the Corporate profile (action sensitive to managed policies).
policy.build-unsupported: Windows build not supported for this action.
policy.edition-unsupported: Windows edition not supported for this action.
actions.empty: No actions available on this page in this version.
actions.profile-hint: Current profile: {0}. Actions that change the system are blocked in the Diagnostics profile - change it in Settings.
actions.intro.quick: Low-risk maintenance actions. Use Preview to see exactly what would happen; nothing runs without your confirmation, one action at a time.
actions.intro.advanced: Individual actions for technicians. Each one shows risk, whether it needs administrator rights and whether it is reversible.
actions.intro.integrity: Official Windows tools (SFC, DISM, CHKDSK). They require administrator rights; output is shown below and in the console.
actions.intro.office: Microsoft Office diagnostics focused on slow Word startup. Nothing is deleted; repairs only open the official tool.
